interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks at intersections or designated mid-block locations to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) at crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Speed Management Measures
interventions.description: Introduce traffic calming such as speed humps or tables to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk to provide a legal and safer crossing point for pedestrians in this commercial zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add vegetation to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while naturally slowing vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing and Marking
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the parking lot entrance and use high-visibility markings or a continuous sidewalk material to reinforce pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically oriented toward the sidewalk to improve visibility and security during evening hours.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Marking a mid-block crossing would provide a designated and more predictable space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to provide space for a dedicated bike lane and wider, buffered sidewalks.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a raised median refuge island to break up the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Full replacement of the degraded sidewalk with a smooth, ADA-compliant concrete surface to eliminate trip hazards.

interventions.title: Curb Extension and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a furniture zone or planting strip between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Clear Path Maintenance
interventions.description: Ensure a consistent clear walking width by managing building encroachments and maintaining the pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated and predictable crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the degraded asphalt to eliminate tripping hazards and improve overall safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Bollards
interventions.description: Install physical bollards along the curb line to prevent vehicles from parking on and obstructing the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to provide a safe crossing point on this long block.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide a physical and psychological barrier.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Implement continental-style marked crosswalks accompanied by pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Raised Pedestrian Crossing at Driveway
interventions.description: Elevate the sidewalk across the driveway entrance to maintain pedestrian priority and slow entering/exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to provide a 3-7 second head start for pedestrians before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the near side of the roadway to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with RRFB
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.
